effects.label: Regeneration
effects.description: Heals the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the buff. The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This buff can be stacked.

levels.text: Casts a [Regeneration] on 8 allies in a 11m radius around Solnor, lasting 4s. The [Regeneration] buff ticks 1 time every 2s. Each tick heals the target by (1.5% * Target's MAX HP) HP.

bio: When he was young, Solnor left the Eldrin to seek solace in nature, hoping to escape the cycle of war. He learned much, but one thing above all: isolation solved nothing. So he returned, armed with mycelial magic and decades of knowledge, hoping to bring peace rather than wait for it.
